This petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (corresponding to Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973) seeks quashing of FIR No. 168/2024 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S. Jamia Nagar, and all other proceedings emanating therefrom, on the basis of settlement between the Petitioner No. 1 and Respondent No. 3.
2.
Counsel for the Petitioner places reliance on a Memorandum of Understanding dated 28th November, 2025.
The said settlement records that the parties have agreed to live peacefully without any dispute.
However, in the opinion of this Court, the settlement does not clearly spell out the nature of the understanding between the parties.
